_comment: Linux IAM Lab settings. Paths may use %USERPROFILE% / %LOCALAPPDATA%. The lab touches ONLY the VM whose UUID and install id are recorded in state.json.
_cpusNote: 1 vCPU: Linux guests with 2+ vCPUs hang at boot when VirtualBox runs on top of the Windows hypervisor (NEM). Raise only if Hyper-V/VBS/WSL2 are off.
_startModeNote: gui = Start opens the VirtualBox window with the Linux desktop (portal + terminal inside Linux). headless = no window; use the portal from Windows.
